new_claim.scope: A=U Lambda U^T has rank exactly 3, U^T U=I_3, all |lambda_j|>=1, and every row u_i of U has norm <=1/2; arbitrary independent real input densities <=1.
new_claim.conclusion: With B_RV the absolute small-coordinate Fourier-integral constant in the Rudelson-Vershynin Brascamp-Lieb proof, |phi_Q(t)| <= [B_RV^3/(8*pi^(3/2))]|det Lambda|^(-1/2)|t|^(-3/2), integral_R |phi_Q(t)| dt <= 2+B_RV^3/(2*pi^(3/2)), and Q has a bounded continuous density with ||p_Q||_infinity <= 1/pi+B_RV^3/(4*pi^(5/2)).
